name: grammar-b-loop
prompt: Cold analog synths meet warm reverb. The drone begins to listen. The arpeggio begins to respond. The kick begins to breathe. A four-bar pattern in C minor develops self-awareness through 144 repetitions, each pass adding a small change, until the loop knows it is a loop.
extra: gradual evolution across repetitions, ending with a single sustained tone
subject: the self-aware loop (144 repetitions)
